title: Final Pressure Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and state that the pressure p equals u/3 for an isotropic radiation field.

title: Thermodynamic Argument
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide a clear thermodynamic argument showing that the energy density of blackbody radiation depends only on temperature.

title: Functional Form Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the functional form of p(T) from thermodynamic reasoning, indicating the relationship between pressure and temperature.

title: Energy Density Relation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state that the energy density u is proportional to T^4, leading to the conclusion about pressure.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the derivation of pressure and energy density relationships.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check for consistency in units throughout the derivations and final equations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that no multiplicative constants are omitted in the final expressions for pressure and energy density.
